desks.Dividends: Nvidia Dec 2 is the only dated dividend event in the next four weeks — $0.25 per quarter, unchanged, payable Dec 23. No increases, cuts, or specials anywhere. SPY's December distribution is expected around Dec 18 and QQQ's around Dec 21–22, neither yet declared. Yields are thin after the rebound: Microsoft 0.80%, Nvidia 0.66%, Apple 0.30% — none is an income opportunity at current prices.
desks.Earnings: No watchlist name reports earnings in the next two weeks (Nov 27–Dec 11); the next prints cluster in late January 2027 (Microsoft Jan 26 earliest — all dates estimates, UNVERIFIED until the company confirms). Adjacent prints to watch: Salesforce and Snowflake Dec 2, Broadcom and Adobe Dec 9, Costco Dec 10. Broadcom/Adobe consensus is disputed across feeds on a GAAP vs adjusted basis, unresolved.
desks.Futures: The Gulf supply-risk premium is now the marginal crude driver — Brent settled $96.57 Thursday, highest since Nov 6, on the Ras Tanura and Jazan refinery strikes; OPEC+ meets Sun Nov 29, with a rollover of current targets the reported expectation. EIA printed a commercial crude build (+1.1M bbl) with record US production of 14.065M b/d; natural gas made its first seasonal withdrawal (-24 Bcf). USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies — not in force, comments due Jan 5, hearings Jan 25. Gold snapped back Friday, +2.9% to $3,639.60.
desks.Parity: No parity violation was found on the watchlist; parity holds within the funding/friction band. Cboe's AM-settled weekly SPX options (SPXO) are a different settlement basis — do not mix AM-settled SPXO and PM-settled SPX/SPXW roots in one box; the next live test is the Dec 16 SPXO expiry. Box-spread financing reads as funding cost plus about 120bp dealer rent at the long end, not a mispricing.
desks.Premium: IV prints are back, 6/6, on the Nov 26 file (Nov 25 close data) and a live Nov 27 pull. SPY/QQQ cleared the stale-jump screen (single-day variance shares 27.1%/25.5%); Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Tesla are still WINDOW-CONTINGENT (32–58%). Live 30-day IVs sit below 20-day realized vol for all six, but no clean 'cheap premium' call. IV rank UNVERIFIED for all six.
desks.Quant lab: Six new candidates ledgered (#410–415), run max 54, nothing TEST- or INTEGRATE-ready. Most relevant is #411, a deep implied-volatility factor model for single-name IV surfaces that touches Apple around earnings. #209 updated: LLM research agents report beat-the-mean in 16–44% of 110 null samples vs 8% Holm-adjusted — a false-positive warning for agent-run backtests.

headline: Daily research brief — Friday, November 27

items.detail: Tally 5 HIKE / 0 CUT / 5 NEUTRAL, unchanged. Core PCE re-anchored hotter (October y/y +3.26% vs 3.2% consensus) and Q3 GDP was revised to +4.3%. items.detail: Brent settled $96.57 Thursday, highest since Nov 6, on the claimed Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and the confirmed projectile strike on the Jazan refinery. Damage and any supply loss at Ras Tanura are UNVERIFIED — satellite imagery suggests a hit, Saudi authorities did not confirm. OPEC+ meets Sunday, November 29; the reported expectation is a rollover of current targets for at least Q1 2027. USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs of up to 20% on China and 35% on Vietnam — proposed only, not priced, a January-2027 tail-risk for watchlist semis, electronics, and autos.
